name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) requires the key to be held when the ball is out of the way or acquired later, matching the task. The ball-out-of-the-way condition is not an unconditional goal.

texts: Whenever the ball is out of the way of the door, the matching key must be held then or acquired later.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
